# Disagreement Log — GTH_108

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 108
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 108 | "the hidden things will be revealed to him" | "what is hidden will be disclosed to him" | "what has been hidden will be revealed to them" | Hidden things: specific category vs. general; pronoun gender |
| 2 | 108 | "I myself shall become" | "I myself will become" | "I will become that person myself" | Emphasis placement: myself (subject) vs. myself (emphasis) |

**Total disagreements: 2**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "the hidden things" (category noun, as in Coptic *apokrupha*), "revealed" (over "disclosed"), and "I myself shall become" (emphasis on the surprising subject).
